newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 833 MW Beaver Valley 2 nuke restart disrupted.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 833 MW Beaver Valley 2 nuke restart disrupted.

text.p: Restart of the 833 megawatt (MW) Beaver Valley 2 nuclear generating unit was disrupted after it was manually shut Tuesday to repair its vessel head vent system, the operator said Wednesday.

"I have no estimate on the time required to make that repair. Therefore, I can't estimate the time when the reactor would come back on line or when it would come back to full service," said a spokesman for Duquesne Light Co.
Beaver Valley 2 remained in "hot standby" mode, which means the unit is still prepared for restart, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said in Wednesday daily status report.
Beaver Valley 2 was previously shut August 30 for a scheduled refueling outage.
Duquesne Light Co previously said it planned to return Beaver Valley 2 on line today, and restore it to full service as early as Thursday.
DQE Inc, Duquesne's parent company, holds 13.7 percent stake in Beaver Valley 2, Ohio Edison (41.9 percent) and Centerior Energy (44.4 percent).
